messages:
elaine: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for a new console dashboard example showing per-customer cost attribution for KV-cache + batching. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4828 :eyes: Need quick review from eng-platform and SDK folks.

raj: quick note: tracing hook snippet still uses old `trace_id` param, should be `trace_context` per runtime v2. See https://go.link/trace-v2 — we should standardize the examples.

mike: can we add a tiny Rust SDK snippet showing how to attach trace context + cost labels? I started one locally, dropping it here. Also will add a one-line Python example link.

deploy-bot: CI: docs build passed ✅ — 48s

lisa: migration question — anyone tried porting existing tenant dashboards to this new attribution widget for Dedicated customers? we need a short migration note for the enterprise guide.

elaine: good call. I'll add a 'Migration' section to the PR. @raj — can you confirm the `trace_context` field name? @mike please add Rust and Python examples; keep Node snippet as-is for parity. :+1:

raj: confirmed — it's `trace_context`. Also update the sample metrics query to pull `kv_cache_hits` and group by `tenant_id` so the example matches billing exports. e.g. `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits[5m])) by (tenant_id)` in the example block.

mike: Rust snippet (draft):
```rust
// minimal example showing trace + labels
use redwood_sdk::{Client, TraceContext};

#[tokio::main]\\nasync fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let client = Client::from_env();
    let tx = TraceContext::new("tenant:1234");
    let resp = client
        .generate("gpt-rlhf-v1")
        .with_trace(tx)
        .with_cost_labels([("tenant_id","1234"), ("cache","kv")])
        .send()
        .await?;
    println!("ok: {:?}", resp);
    Ok(())
}
```

Also a tiny Python gist: https://gist.github.com/mike/kv-cost-example

elaine: perfect — please avoid non-API names (no underscores in example metric labels). Also add a short JSON export example for the dashboard so Dedicated teams can import.

mike: will add a dashboard export + a sample promql query and a short import note. One question: where should the dashboard JSON live in the repo? docs/samples/console/observability/dashboards/ or console/examples/?

elaine: put it under docs/samples/console/observability/dashboards/ and add an index.md that links to it and the Rust/Python snippets. Keep filenames stable for import automation.

raj: also fix the broken link in the intro: https://old.link/kv -> https://docs.redwood.com/kv-cache (I caught this while testing links).

lisa: small UX ask from product — can the example screenshot include a split: token cost vs cache-saved cost? they'd like a tiny table screenshot for the overview.

elaine: will include two small screenshots (low-res) and alt text for accessibility. If no objections I'll merge end of day and then follow up with a cleanup PR for snippet formatting. :rocket:

mike: :thumbsup: I'll open the follow-up PR for codegen snippet fixes after merge.

raj: tiny nit — add a one-line unit/integration test that ensures the example query references `tenant_id` so we don't regress it.

elaine: added to my checklist. Thanks all, merging later today unless blockers.

(threads like this are short — ping me if you want to pair on the migration section)
